GlobalOptions_description: Settings every task uses. In MXU all instances share these values; in MFAAvalonia each instance has its own.
MirrorTargetFloor_description:
Past floor 5 needs the whole run HARD. From floor 6, the game requires every floor of the run to be HARD. So every enabled team must play HARD from floor 1, and its usage cannot be Normal only. The Difficulty cannot be Normal either. If not, the Mirror Dungeon task stops at its start and says why.

For now, each run still stops at floor 5. The bot cannot yet switch on Parallel Superposition at the entrance, so it uses no weekly bonus either.
MirrorRunsLimit_description: On: the Mirror Dungeon task stops when this many runs have claimed their rewards. A run that gives up its rewards does not count. Off: there is no limit, and the task runs until another stop condition holds.
MirrorThemePackRefresh_description: The bot uses the floor's free refreshes only while the best pack on the page is below the plan's threshold. Then it takes the pack with the highest weight, the leftmost among equals.
MirrorWeeklyBonusUse_description: Weekly bonus rewards on Normal runs are tiny. Use them on Hard runs instead.
MirrorStopWhenBonusOut: Stop when weekly bonuses run out
MirrorAfterRetries_description: What the bot does when the retries after a wipe are used up, or when fewer of a team's deployment order are alive than its threshold. Forfeit the run: no rewards, and the same team plays the next run.
WholeNumberFromOne: Enter a whole number, 1 or more
WholeNumberFromZero: Enter a whole number, 0 or more
WebhookUrl_description: Empty = none. When a task stops, the bot sends why to this address.
AutoAcceptTerms_description: Accept the User Agreement on the title screen (off: stop and notify)
AutoDownload_description: Accept game data downloads and updates (off: stop and notify)
KeepDismissedScreens: Save a screenshot before closing a screen
KeepDismissedScreens_description: Save a screenshot before closing a screen (it shows the account: do not share it). The bot saves it only on this computer, in logs/dismissed. It saves these screens: notices, popups, the mailbox, the settings menu, help pages and the Parallel Superposition prompt. It also saves the screen before recovery presses Back.
